articles.summary: Agenus Inc. (Nasdaq: AGEN) , a leader in immuno-oncology innovation, today announced that a poster evaluating botensilimab (BOT), an Fc-enhanced multifunctional anti-CTLA-4 antibody, in combination with balstilimab (BAL), an anti-PD-1 antibody, has been accepted for presentation at the International Gynecologic Cancer Society (IGCS) Annual Global Meeting, taking place October 1–3, 2026, in Montreal, Canada. The presentation will feature results from the recurrent ovarian cancer cohort of the large Phase 1b C-800-01 study, including patients with platinum-refractory/resistant disease, with analyses by platinum sensitivity status and long-term three-year overall survival. Presentation Details: Abstract Title: Next Generation Immune Checkpoint Inhibition with Botensilimab Plus Balstilimab in Recurrent Ovarian Cancer: Results by Platinum Sensitivity Status and 3-Year Overall Survival Presenter: Rebecca L. Porter, M.D.; Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, Boston, MA, USA Poster
articles.title: Agenus to Present Three-Year Overall Survival Data for BOT+BAL in Recurrent Ovarian Cancer at IGCS 2026
